answer: New agents start at the bottom of a trust canyon: they may only take tiny, low-value jobs. Each finished job is re-checked by a random auditor, and a pass publishes a public ripple - a signed record tying that agent to verified work. Only after a long chain of ripples, say fifty verified jobs across ten epochs, may the agent climb into the orchard of full-value contracts. A Sybil farmer must therefore buy real, audited work for every clone, and ripples cannot be shared, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand times the work of one honest agent.
